about: What both plugins say of the installed archvow (1.0.0): each case - the installed archvow (null: it did not answer), the contract the plugin speaks, the archvow it is tested with, the project's pin - against contract/archvow-range.txt. Written by UPDATE_COMPAT=1 npm test (vscode/compat.ts); the IntelliJ plugin must give the same (CompatRegression).

expected.text: archvow 2.8.0 is older than this plugin works with (archvow >=3.0,<4). Install archvow 3.0.0.
archvow 2.8.0 est plus ancien que ce avec quoi ce plugin fonctionne (archvow >=3.0,<4). Installer archvow 3.0.0.

archvow 2.8.0 is older than this plugin works with (archvow >=3.0,<4). This project pins archvow==2.8.0 (requirements.txt). Its architects upgrade the project on a branch - pip install archvow==3.0.0, then archvow init <package> --force, review and merge (archvow's CHANGELOG says what changes); the plugin installs nothing over the pin.

archvow 2.8.0 est plus ancien que ce avec quoi ce plugin fonctionne (archvow >=3.0,<4). Ce projet fixe archvow==2.8.0 (requirements.txt). Ses architectes mettent le projet à jour sur une branche - pip install archvow==3.0.0, puis archvow init <package> --force, relecture et merge (le CHANGELOG d'archvow dit ce qui change) ; le plugin n'installe rien par-dessus le choix du projet.
